hero.subtitle: In fixed income, the money you don't lose matters more than the yield you chase.

whoWeAre.title: Who we are
paragraphs: Arculus Funds Management (GCI Australia AFSL 346034) is an Australian fixed income manager, operating since 2013. We manage over $1.2bn (AUD) across two retail unit trusts, wholesale strategies and private mandates for family offices, charities and wealth advisory groups.

The team has amassed more than a century's collective knowledge through several full market cycles, across fixed income, equities, derivatives and hybrids. That experience shapes a simple view: in fixed income, the money you don't lose matters more than the yield you chase.

philosophy.title: Our philosophy
items: Every portfolio is built to preserve capital before it pursues return. We hold investment grade rated bonds issued under Australian law, in Australian dollars. No leverage, no structured credit, no foreign currency exposure.

We are benchmark unaware. Duration is set by where we are in the cycle, not by an index. When rates are rising and supported by the inflation story, we run low fixed duration and low credit-spread duration. When rates peak we increase duration to capture capital gains in a falling rate environment. Income comes from our experience in getting that read right, rather than moving down the credit curve.

We do not hold, value, or administer the assets we manage. The funds are monitored for mandate compliance by the external responsible entity, trustee or investor. The administrator values the portfolio daily and calculates performance independently of us. There are 4 eyes on every transaction: Custody – Administration – Investment Management and the Responsible Entity.

whatWeDo.title: What we do
items: We invest only in investment grade bonds (S&P, Fitch or Moody's rated) issued under Australian law, in AUD
Offer daily pricing and daily redemption on both public funds
Charge a flat management fee. No performance fee, so there is no incentive to take on risk
